Ways to work together

Every project is quoted to fit what you actually need. These are the shapes most work takes.

Brand refresh

For businesses whose visuals no longer match the quality of what they do. A focused direction and production sprint that rebuilds your library of photos and film.

  • Visual direction
  • One or more shoot days
  • A library of edited stills and video

Campaign production

For launching a product, promoting an offer or running a creative campaign. Concept through to finished assets, cut for every place they'll run.

  • Campaign concept
  • Film and photography
  • Channel-ready cutdowns and ad assets

Ongoing creative partner

For brands that need fresh, consistent content every month without briefing a new supplier each time. A recurring shoot cadence and a planned content pipeline.

  • Monthly or quarterly production
  • Content planning
  • Ad and social asset adaptation

Our story

The Genesis of TBP

Dave Morrison, founder and lead director

Tired Boy Productions is a standalone company out of Toronto, ON that aims to give up-and-coming artists the ability to have high-quality music videos at the lowest possible pricing.

Led by founder and lead director Dave Morrison, the team has made a name for themselves in the Toronto rap, R&B and pop music communities.

Dave first had the idea for the company when he found there was a massive demand for music videos in the summer of 2019. The Toronto music scene was short on visual content, and there was an opportunity to benefit the community through film.

After an initial investment and business plan were made, it was off to the races.

The name “Tired Boy Productions” comes from the tireless hours that Dave and his team put into shooting, directing and editing videos for clients.

It is Dave’s goal to make the music video part of an artist’s journey as price-efficient as possible, so they can blast off by investing in other areas.
